## Type of change

<!-- Check all that apply: -->

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor (no functional change, no API change)
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX (visual polish, responsive tweaks)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance (matching engine, render, network)
- [ ] 🔒 Security (auth, secrets, headers)
- [ ] 📦 Build / CI / Infra (Docker, Helm, GitHub Actions, deps)
- [ ] 📝 Docs (README, code comments, CONTRIBUTING)

## Related issues

<!-- e.g. Closes #123, Refs #456 -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run lint` passes locally
- [ ] `bun run build` passes locally
- [ ] `bun run test:unit` passes locally
- [ ] I tested the change in the browser (desktop + mobile)
- [ ] I tested the change on the **preview environment** (the bot will comment a URL on this PR after CI passes)
- [ ] I added/updated tests where applicable (unit, property, e2e, visual regression)
- [ ] I added a Storybook story for any new component
- [ ] I updated the README / docs where applicable
- [ ] I added a CHANGELOG.md entry under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or `.env` files are committed (pre-commit hook should catch this)
- [ ] DB schema changes are backward-compatible (or include a migration)
- [ ] If visual changes: I updated the Playwright visual regression baselines (`just test-e2e-update`) — only if the change is intentional
